# ALP Dynamic Time & Countdowns 1.0.27

**Make every second count.** Explore 20 customizable countdown designs, dynamic dates, anniversaries, reusable shortcodes and more. All features included in this release are available for free.

### Highlights since the previous WordPress.org release

- Polished, responsive Solid/Gradient Color Picker with editable angles, HEX, opacity and reusable Quick Colors gradient presets.
- Refined Flip Digits transitions and card radius controls, including square corners at 0px.
- Individual spacing and corner-radius options for supported countdown designs.
- Improved 3D Odometer and Liquid layouts, gradient preview accuracy and contextual help.
- Compatibility with legacy `[years-since]` and `[years-since-gb]` shortcode forms when these aliases are not registered by another plugin.
- Security, escaping, privacy, performance and WordPress.org Plugin Check refinements.

### Moving from Years Since – Timeless Texts?

This plugin is independent of Years Since – Timeless Texts, which was closed in the WordPress.org directory. Existing shortcodes may continue working via compatibility aliases, but please verify your pages after disabling the former plugin. ALP Dynamic Time & Countdowns is not affiliated with its original developers.

### Requirements

- WordPress 6.5+
- PHP 8.2+
- Optional Divi 5 module, Gutenberg block and regular shortcodes

Detailed change history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/alex-alp-plugins/alp-dynamic-time-and-countdowns/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
